abilities.flavor: The first blow is the charge sheet.
One swing, and the whole bench hears it.
Stand behind me and the stone holds.
Every stored blow, delivered at once.
The watch does not sleep, and it does not bend.
Order in the hall. Now.
Plant the heels. Let it break on me.
You. Answer to me.
A falling wall still hits like a wall.
Set the beat; let the others land on it.
The same line, sung again, changes the song.
Every voice at once, on the downbeat.
The wrong note, struck on purpose.
Stand in the song and it carries you.
Not one more word.
A verse held up like a buckler.
Sing the curse out of the blood.
The melody moves, and so do you.
A coal thrown hard enough to matter.
Light the mark; let the others burn it.
All that heat, quenched in one crack of ice.
Spend the fire you have been holding.
The floor remembers the fire.
A breath of frost snuffs the spell.
Burned once, the skin will not burn again.
Burn away what does not belong.
Gone like a spark up the flue.
